vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — RFC 8785 canonicalization
note: Abstract strings and published number samples only. No external observation and no signing material.

cases.wire_note: These samples document RFC 8785 number serialization only. A count, byte size, instant or exact decimal on the canonical wire is never emitted with a fractional or exponent token.
Canonical manifest and record member order is UTF-16 code unit order over member names.
The canonical bytes are the sole input to digesting, ordering and signing.
Count and byte size use a JSON integer below 2^53, or a decimal string for the full u64 range, selected by value.
